description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android widget extending TextView used for displaying log messages received via the LogNode interface. It formats log data, including priority, tag, message, and exceptions, and outputs them to the UI, optionally chaining to the next LogNode.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays log information passed through the LogNode interface, formatting and appending log entries, and supporting chaining to other LogNodes.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructors for creating LogView instances with different parameter configurations.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and displays a log message, including optional exception stack trace, and forwards to the next LogNode if defined.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string to a StringBuilder if it is not null, adding a delimiter.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a log string as a new line in the LogView display.
